products.name: CoCounsel (Casetext)
products.note: Legal research AI; litigation support; Westlaw integration; attorney work product risk

profile_text.body:
Thomson Reuters is a publicly traded global content and technology company, listed on both Nasdaq and TSX under the ticker TRI (CIK 0001075124), that describes itself as delivering technology with purpose to help professionals make faster decisions and gain sharper insights. Its stated focus areas span legal, tax, trade compliance, accounting, risk, and fraud sectors, with an emphasis on connecting research, analysis, and drafting workflows for professional services firms and related organizations.

The company's primary AI product tracked here is CoCounsel, developed through its Casetext acquisition, which integrates with Westlaw and Practical Law to provide legal research, litigation support, and document drafting capabilities. Thomson Reuters describes CoCounsel as built on principles it calls "Fiduciary-Grade AI," intended for work requiring defensible outputs. The company is also launching what it describes as its first production-grade agentic workflows on CoCounsel, designed to handle multi-step tasks. A separate platform, ONESOURCE+, is described as bringing tax, trade, legal, and risk functions together in an AI-powered connected approach. The company has cited a customer case in which a firm called Justly Prudent used CoCounsel and Westlaw AI and reported increasing litigation capacity by 100%. Thomson Reuters has also published annual research reports, including the 2026 Future of Professionals Report and the 2026 AI in Professional Services Report, the latter drawing on perspectives from more than 1,500 professionals across relevant sectors.
